title: Redesign TaskTodoWidget as non-displacing overlay popover pill to eliminate chat displacement and divider stripes
summary: Redesigned TaskTodoWidget so the plan list floats as an overlay popover (z-30 shadow-xl rounded-xl border border-[#ebebeb] bg-white) with outside-click and Escape listeners, completely preventing chat feed displacement. Removed the full-width divider stripe ('border-t border-[#ebebeb] bg-[#fafafa]') above the input area, anchoring a compact pill trigger ('To-dos X/Y') in the steer bar toolbar adjacent to the input controls.
